title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About us 
 At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.
 The role 
 Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.
 You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
 You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.
 Key responsibilities 
 Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.
 Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.
 Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.
 Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.
 Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.
 Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.
 Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.
 Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.
 Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.
 Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.
 Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.
 Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.
 Your background 
 You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:
 A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.
 Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.
 Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.
 A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.
 A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.
 Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.
 You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦ 
 Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;
 Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;
 Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.
 Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.
 Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â  These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â  The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â  We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.
 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Engineering or highly technical product background.
 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.
 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â  
 Outcome

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 Our process is designed to move fast:

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
 We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
 The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
 This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
 What you'll do 
 Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up
 Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it
 Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work
 Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them
 Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does
 Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of
 Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting
 Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable
 What we're looking for 
 Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required
 Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist
 AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further
 High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first
 Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others
 Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it
 Backgrounds that tend to fit 
 Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company
 MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them
 Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report
 Why this is interesting 
 Competitive, top-of-market compensation
 You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook
 Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early
 Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

title: Product Manager
description:
Ripjar was founded by veterans of GCHQ to bring national security-grade intelligence tools to the fight against financial crime. Financial crime funds human trafficking, terrorism, corruption and sanctions evasion on a global scale, and the organisations on the front line need technology built to match the threat.
Today, Ripjar's AI-native software and data fusion products are used by governments, the world's largest banks, and global enterprises to automate the detection, investigation and monitoring of serious financial crime. Every day, hundreds of customers and thousands of daily active users rely on the platform to screen hundreds of millions of names for risk in real time, prevent money laundering and stop terrorist financing.
If you want your work to matter, this is where it happens.
We are a remote first team, with a head office based in Cheltenham. This position is open to UK wide candidates. If you are based near Cheltenham, you are more than welcome to work from our office at any time.
 The role:
 We are looking for a motivated, curious, and enthusiastic Product Manager to join our growing product team. This is not a role where we expect you to have seen it all before or be an expert in every discipline. We believe great product instincts combined with the right attitude will take you far, and this role is designed to be a launchpad for your career.
Product management at Ripjar is beautifully varied, and we want you to find your own strengths. While you will get a solid grounding in the entire product lifecycle, you will have the flexibility to lean into the areas that excite you most as you develop:
 The Tech and Delivery Side: Partnering closely with world-class engineers and architects to build cutting-edge systems. 
 The Commercial and Marketing Side: Shaping product strategy, exploring pricing models, and helping position our products in the global market. 
 The Operational Side: Working on how our complex AI systems are deployed and implemented effectively for our clients. 
 Bring Your Ideas to Shape How the World Fights Financial Crime with AI
 AI is at the heart of what we do. We don't just want you to manage a roadmap; we want you to bring your own creativity and ideas to the table. You will help us think about how we can leverage the next generation of AI tools and processes to make a meaningful difference. If you are fascinated by the fast-moving world of artificial intelligence and want to apply it to real-world challenges, you will thrive here.
 What you'll be doing:
 Lead and Shape Initiatives: Be responsible for key product features from concept through to launch, working alongside UX designers, engineers, and QA specialists. 
 Listen and Learn: Engage directly with our customers and internal teams to deeply understand user needs and domain challenges. 
 Build Momentum: Act as an Agile product owner by writing user stories, collaborating team ceremonies, and helping the team deliver. 
 Experiment with Strategy: Contribute fresh ideas to our product development, marketing strategies, and pricing approaches
 Requirements
 What we're looking for:

 Job Title: Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff
 Job ID: NAFSAM1EA
 Industry: Music Production & Consulting
 Location: South Africa / LATAM / Philippines
 Job Status: Full Time (40 Hours Per Week)
 Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern Time
 Salary: $2000 per month
 Target Start Date: ASAP
 🏢 About the Client 
 The client is an acclaimed music producer, creative entrepreneur, and high-velocity ideator operating a lean, independent practice across high-touch creative projects and strategic initiatives. Operating at a rapid, highly intuitive pace, the founder constantly leverages cutting-edge AI tools (such as Claude, Manus, Gemini, and Instinct) to push creative boundaries across music production, client engagements, and consulting projects. As an artist-operator whose strength lies in continuous idea generation, the founder’s primary operational bottlenecks are execution, schedule management, and consistent follow-through.
 💼 About the Role 
 This role exists because the founder generates a high volume of ideas and initiatives—often accelerated by AI tools—and requires a high-agency operational partner to capture, organize, and drive them to 100% completion. Positioned as an Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff with "big shoulders," the candidate will act as an authoritative gatekeeper, schedule owner, and execution manager.
 Rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions, the successful candidate will actively manage up, enforce priorities, drive delegation to team members, and maintain full 24-hour visibility over the founder’s daily cadence to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
 🎯 Key Responsibilities 
 📅 1. 24-Hour Schedule Ownership & Managing Up
 Total Schedule Visibility: Own the founder's calendar and routine end-to-end. Monitor his 24-hour cadence to anticipate delays, track whether commitments were completed, and prevent him from getting bogged down in low-value tasks.
 Assertive Direction & Gatekeeping: Function as his "agent" or "boss" when necessary. Direct his focus to top priorities, establish strict boundary control against distractions, and firmly enforce deadlines without hesitating out of politeness.
 Energy Alignment: Recognize when he is "in the zone" versus when he is getting off-track, adjusting daily workflows dynamically to maintain momentum.
 🧠 2. Idea Capture, Synthesis & AI Orchestration
 Brain-Dump Refinement: Synthesize the founder's rapid-fire, intuitive, and sometimes unorganized ideas into structured action items, delegation tracks, and project scopes.
 AI Tool Integration: Actively co-work with AI engines (Manus, Gemini, Claude, Instinct, etc.). Take prompt outputs, bridge workflows between tools, organize synthesized outputs, and translate raw AI drafts into finalized operational assets.
 ⚡ 3. Delegation & Bottleneck Elimination
 Force Delegation: Actively spot tasks the founder is doing himself that should be offloaded, pushing them to team members (such as project managers or contractors).
 Uncompromising Accountability (The "100% Standard"): Maintain zero tolerance for loose ends. If a project or task is completed to 99% instead of 100%, step in immediately to close the remaining 1% so the founder never has to audit or double-check work.
 Root-Cause Analysis: When tasks are delayed, investigate why they were pushed off—identifying structural bottlenecks rather than accepting surface-level excuses.
 🎵 4. Creative Production Support
 Track multi-project timelines across music production, high-touch client engagements, and consulting initiatives.
 Manage asset handoffs using Dropbox and maintain basic operational awareness of studio production environments.
 ✅ Candidate Profile & Qualifications 
 ⭐ Character & Personality Traits (The "Big Shoulders"): 
 High Agency: Possesses the emotional maturity, confidence, and resilience to hold a fast-moving, highly creative executive accountable without getting overwhelmed, confused, or defensive.
 Hungry, Driven & Assertive: Highly motivated to take full ownership. Refuses to step back or give "too much space" when momentum is needed; balances kindness with firm, decisive execution.
 Counterbalance to Creatives: Thrives on taking spontaneous, random, and rapid-fire creative output and creating operational order and predictability out of chaos.
 📋 Professional Qualifications & Skills:
 Obsessive Attention to Detail (100% Rule): High operational standards. Naturally spots skewed frames on a wall, missed audio takes in a music folder, or forgotten line items in a budget.
 Systems-Oriented & AI-Fluent: Comfortable using AI agents, LLMs, and modern automation tools daily to organize chaos and accelerate output.
 Extremely Proactive Communications: Comfortable pressing for answers, asking sharp direct questions, and driving conversations rather than waiting to be managed.
 💻 Tech Stack 
 AI Ecosystem: Manus, Gemini, Claude, Instinct, Marbleism
 Media & File Infrastructure: Dropbox, Google Workspace, Project Management Tools (Asana/ClickUp)
 Industry Software: Basic working knowledge/familiarity with Avid Pro Tools and audio production workflows is a major plus.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence – Fashion & Luxury AI Venture | BIANCO VENTURES
description:
Bianco Ventures è un company builder verticale dedicato alla creazione di startup software B2B per il mondo Fashion & Luxury. Uniamo capitale, execution e conoscenza profonda del mercato fin dal primo giorno, insieme a partner come Deloitte, GELLIFY e ARAD, per costruire nuove imprese con chi conosce il settore dall'interno. 
 Non siamo un fondo. Non siamo un acceleratore. Costruiamo imprese vere, partendo da problemi veri. 
 La venture oggetto di questa ricerca è la prima iniziativa live del nostro ecosistema. Stiamo cercando la persona che la guidi. 
 La sfida
 Nelle organizzazioni retail distribuite, decine, centinaia di punti vendita, mercati diversi, team locali con autonomia operativa, il coordinamento tra struttura centrale e rete è uno dei problemi più persistenti e ancora poco risolti dalla tecnologia. 
 Le linee guida partono dall'HQ. Cosa succede dopo è spesso invisibile. L'execution reale, la qualità con cui le direttive diventano azione nei singoli store, viene misurata tardi, se viene misurata. I dati ci sono, ma sono frammentati, manuali, non strutturati. 
 Questo è il problema che stiamo affrontando. 
 La venture
 Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma B2B software e AI focalizzata sulla retail execution e sull'operational intelligence per il Fashion, il Luxury e il Retail mid-market. 
 La venture nasce da un'analisi concreta del mercato e da interlocuzioni dirette con i decision maker del settore. La tesi di mercato è sviluppata. La value proposition iniziale è strutturata. Il problema è reale e ancora largamente irrisolto dagli strumenti oggi disponibili. 
 Siamo in fase early-stage. Il prodotto e il modello di business devono ancora essere validati e costruiti, questa è esattamente la ragione per cui stiamo cercando chi voglia farlo. 
 Il ruolo
 Cerchiamo un'Entrepreneur in Residence che agisca come founder operativa/o della venture. 
 Non si tratta di un incarico consulenziale. Non è un ruolo di product management interno. Non è innovation management. 
 È ownership reale di un'impresa in costruzione: dalla customer discovery alla prima revenue, dalla definizione del prodotto alla creazione del team, dal go-to-market alla preparazione allo spin-off. 
 Avrai autonomia concreta. Avrai il supporto di un ecosistema attivo. Avrai accesso a stakeholder industriali che raramente si trovano nella stessa stanza. 
 Cosa farai nei primi 6–9 mesi
 Nei primi mesi costruirai le fondamenta operative e commerciali della venture. In concreto: 
 Approfondirai la customer discovery, intervistando Retail Director, Head of VM, COO e altri decision maker del settore, per validare il problema e misurare la willingness to pay 
 Raffinerai la value proposition in dialogo con il mercato reale, non con ipotesi interne 
 Coordinerai la costruzione dell'MVP con il team tecnologico, definendo le priorità di prodotto in funzione di ciò che hai imparato sul campo 
 Progetterai e gestirai i primi pilot con brand selezionati, raccogliendo evidenze qualitative e quantitative 
 Definirai il modello commerciale (pricing, segmentazione, struttura contrattuale) partendo dai dati, non da benchmark generici 
 Costruirai il go-to-market iniziale e acquisirai i primi clienti paganti 
 Coordinerai partner tecnologici, fornitori e risorse dedicate 
 Definirai KPI e milestone della venture e le presenterai agli stakeholder e ai potenziali investitori 
 Costruirai il primo team intorno alla venture 
 Preparerai la società allo spin-off e al fundraising seed 
 Chi cerchiamo
 Consideriamo profili con 5–10 anni di esperienza che abbiano lavorato in almeno uno di questi ambiti: startup early-stage, venture building, product management B2B, growth, SaaS enterprise, retail tech, AI o innovation. 
 Quello che non è negoziabile:
 Capacità di condurre customer discovery in contesti enterprise, sapere ascoltare, sapere sintetizzare, sapere cambiare idea quando i dati lo richiedono 
 Attitudine commerciale: saper portare una soluzione davanti a un buyer, gestire il ciclo di vendita, chiudere 
 Capacità di lavorare con team tecnologici senza essere necessariamente tecnici: sapere cosa chiedere, come prioritizzare, come tradurre feedback di mercato in decisioni di prodotto 
 Leadership cross-funzionale in contesti ad alta ambiguità: non serve aver fatto tutto, serve saper operare quando le risposte non ci sono ancora 
 Comunicazione efficace con interlocutori senior come executive di brand, investitori, partner istituzionali 
 Inglese professionale fluente 
 Quello che consideriamo un plus significativo:
 Precedente esperienza da founder, anche in iniziative che non sono decollate 
 Conoscenza diretta del Fashion, Luxury o Retail, da operatore, consulente o builder di soluzioni per il settore 
 Vendita di soluzioni SaaS in contesti enterprise o corporate 
 Esposizione a AI applicata, workflow automation o operational intelligence 
 Esperienza in fundraising o nella gestione di pilot con grandi organizzazioni 
 Esperienza in pricing B2B e strutturazione di modelli commerciali 
 Non stiamo cercando una persona che abbia già fatto tutto questo. Stiamo cercando una persona che sappia costruire partendo dall'incertezza, che trasformi l'ambiguità in direzione e la direzione in azione. 
 Cosa offriamo
 Non partirai da zero. 
 Troverai una tesi di mercato già sviluppata, un problema identificato, una value proposition strutturata e un ecosistema attivo che include: 
 Supporto diretto e continuativo del team Bianco Ventures 
 Supporto strategico e go-to-market di Deloitte 
 Sviluppo tecnologico e venture building di GELLIFY 
 Competenze manageriali verticali sul Fashion & Luxury di ARAD

 Equity nella società al momento dello spin-off
